proposals.before: The Lord of Lu suspected him, so Wu Qi killed his wife to seek the generalship.
proposals.after: Wu Qi then went to Lu, studied military methods, and served the Lord of Lu.
proposals.reason: Literal English is a duplicate of the following unit and does not translate 起乃之魯，學兵法以事魯君.

proposals.before: The Lord of Lu suspected him, so Qi killed his wife to seek the generalship.
proposals.after: The Lord of Lu suspected him, so Wu Qi killed his wife to seek the generalship.
proposals.reason: Literal wrongly shortens 起 to Qi (the state) instead of Wu Qi.

proposals.before: After Tian Wen died, Gongsun became chancellor, married a Wei princess, and plotted against Wu Qi.
proposals.after: After Tian Wen died, Gongshu became chancellor, married a Wei princess, and plotted against Wu Qi.
proposals.reason: Chinese 公叔 is Gongshu; Gongsun is a mistranslation inconsistent with s0132.

proposals.before: Gongsun said, “What is to be done?”
proposals.after: Gongshu said, “What is to be done?”
proposals.reason: Chinese 公叔 should be Gongshu, matching the servant line and the name 公叔.

proposals.before: When it came time for the race, Sun Tzu said: 'Now use your lowest chariot against their highest, your highest against their middle, your middle against their lowest.'
proposals.after: When it came time for the race, Sun Bin said: 'Now use your lowest chariot against their highest, your highest against their middle, your middle against their lowest.'
proposals.reason: In the Sun Bin narrative, 孫子 refers to Sun Bin; literal wrongly uses Sun Tzu.

proposals.before: Sun Tzu calculated their march route—they should arrive at Malings by dusk.
proposals.after: Sun Bin calculated their march route—they should arrive at Maling by dusk.
proposals.reason: Referent is Sun Bin; place name 馬陵 is Maling, not Malings.

proposals.before: The Malings road was narrow, with many obstacles and defiles on the sides, suitable for ambushing troops. They cut a large tree white and wrote on it: 'Pang Juan dies beneath this tree.'
proposals.after: The Maling road was narrow, with many obstacles and defiles on the sides, suitable for ambushing troops. They cut a large tree white and wrote on it: 'Pang Juan dies beneath this tree.'
proposals.reason: Place name 馬陵 should be Maling, not Malings.

decisions.reason: s0087 is 起乃之魯，學兵法以事魯君 (Wu Qi then went to Lu, studied military methods, and served the Lord of Lu); the before text is the content of s0088 and does not translate this sentence.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 起乃之魯，學兵法以事魯君

decisions.reason: In 魯君疑之，起殺妻以求將, 起 is Wu Qi’s given name; bare English “Qi” wrongly suggests the state of Qi, and “Wu Qi” correctly identifies the agent.
s0131 has 公叔為相, and s0132 continues 公叔之僕; 公叔 is Gongshu, not Gongsun, so the proposed name correction matches the Chinese.
s0133 opens 公叔曰; the speaker is Gongshu, consistent with 公叔 in s0131–s0132, so replacing Gongsun is required.
In this Sun Bin episode, 孫子曰 names Sun Bin (cf. adjacent units); English “Sun Tzu” misidentifies him as Sun Wu, and “Sun Bin” restores the correct referent.
孫子 again refers to Sun Bin in this campaign narrative, and 馬陵 is the place name Maling; “Sun Tzu” and plural “Malings” are both wrong.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 孫子度其行，暮當至馬陵

decisions.reason: 馬陵道 is the road at Maling; “Malings” is an incorrect English place-name form, and the rest of the proposed literal matches 道陜…斫大樹白而書之.

claimRetractions.reason: Accepted r0003 shows English “Gongsun” was created only by mistranslating 公叔; the Chinese supports Gongshu (c0087), not a separate Gongsun name.
